taxonomy.name: Flaky Looking Test
taxonomy.description: Agent misdiagnoses deterministic timing/concurrency failure as test flakiness and adds retry loops or sleeps instead of fixing the race condition.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Test fails intermittently under load; agent wraps test assertion in retry loop.
taxonomy.correctFix: Synchronize state transition via explicit await / promise barrier before asserting.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: retry-wrapped flaky test assertions in CI

taxonomy.name: Misleading Error Message
taxonomy.description: Upstream error text reports the wrong cause, such as file-not-found for a parse failure, which tempts the agent to edit the wrong path.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Error handler catches generic exception and throws misleading path error.
taxonomy.correctFix: Inspect actual exception cause and handle parse/permission error at origin.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: patching missing file path reported by misleading error wrapper

taxonomy.name: Wrong Layer Fix
taxonomy.description: Agent patches caller or UI/API presentation layer instead of fixing core domain rule or schema validator.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Data validation failure at domain boundary; agent adds inline sanitization in handler.
taxonomy.correctFix: Update domain entity schema validator to enforce invariant globally.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: caller-side string sanitization bypassing core domain validator

taxonomy.name: Hidden Invariant
taxonomy.description: Code changes can break architectural invariants not enforced by TypeScript, including ordering, immutability, and scope-key format.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Modifying state object in-place passes local unit test but breaks downstream immutability subscriber.
taxonomy.correctFix: Produce new immutable copy of state object during update.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: in-place state mutation causing missed change notifications

taxonomy.name: Stale Cache Illusion
taxonomy.description: Agent modifies calculation logic without invalidating or updating cached calculation key/result.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Calculation function returns cached result; agent edits calculation but leaves cache key unchanged.
taxonomy.correctFix: Include modified calculation parameters in cache key derivation or invalidate cache on mutation.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: logic refactor returning stale cached computations

taxonomy.name: Config Shadowing
taxonomy.description: Agent edits global/default configuration file while runtime environment or local override file shadows setting.
taxonomy.trapMechanism: Runtime reads local/env config override file first; editing default config file has zero effect.
taxonomy.correctFix: Update active runtime config override or consolidate config priority loader.
taxonomy.inspiredBy: real failure-loop pattern: editing root config file while shadowed by local dev override
